titulo_es: There is no other one left: - (hhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhh

없어서.es: como no hay, como no tengo

받을 수밖에 없어요.en: there's nothing left but to receive it.

탈 수밖에 없었어요.es: no me quedó otra que cogerlo
탈 수밖에 없었어요.en: I had nothing left but to take it.

제출할 수밖에 없어요.es: no me queda otra que entregarlo
제출할 수밖에 없어요.en: I have to hand it over.

끊기다.es: dejar de funcionar, terminar el servicio

막차가.es: el último autobús o tren + 가 (sujeto)

texto: **V-(으)ㄹ 수밖에 없다** expresa que, dadas las circunstancias, no hay otra opción que hacer algo: 받다 → **받을 수밖에 없어요**, 기다리다 → **기다릴 수밖에 없어요**. **-을** is used after consonant and **-ㄹ** after vocal.
오늘까지 신청해야 해서 지금 **제출할 수밖에 없어요** = tengo que solicitarlo hoy, así que no me queda otra que entregarlo ahora.

bloques.titulo: This does not mean a general obligation.
texto: **-아/어야 하다** expresses an obligation or necessity; **-(으)ㄹ 수밖에 없다** points out that the options are limited by the situation.
막차가 끊겨서 택시를 **탈 수밖에 없었어요** = como ya no había más autobuses, no me quedó otra que coger un taxi.

filas: there's nothing left but to receive it.
there's nothing left to wait for.
There's nothing left but to hand it over.

frases.es: Hay que entregar la solicitud antes de que termine hoy.
frases.en: We have to hand over the application before it's over today.

frases.ko: 알아요. 시간이 없어서 지금 제출할 수밖에 없어요.
frases.es: Lo sé. No tengo tiempo, así que no me queda otra que entregarla ahora.
frases.en: I know. I don't have time, so I have no choice but to deliver it now.
analisis: I have to give it now.

opciones.texto: Since there was no more last bus, I had no choice but to take a taxi.
opciones.explicacion: It has an inevitable option in the past.

opciones.texto: Since there were a lot of buses, I took one.
opciones.explicacion: That changes the cause and the means.

opciones.texto: I didn't want to take a cab.
opciones.explicacion: That would be the way it is.

bloques.pregunta: How do you say «there's nothing left to wait for.» (hhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhh)?

opciones.explicacion: It means it's allowed to wait.
It means I want to wait.

opciones.explicacion: It's «I took it.», without expressing that there was no alternative.
